methodHandling.otherMethods: 405 {"error":"POST only"} checked BEFORE requireUser (an unauthenticated GET gets 405, not 401)

auth.notes: Needs canEdit on the brand: 404 if unreachable, 403 if read-only org member.

fields.name: layouts
fields.bounds: each a non-negative integer; all three keys required
fields.validation: parseArchetypeLayouts: non-object or any key missing/non-integer/negative -> 400 'layouts must map cover, divider and content to layout indices'. Extra keys ignored. Same index may be used for several archetypes.

checkOrder: 6. read all 3 layout previews (404/422) before any write

kit.furnitureKey: only when furniture rebuilt with >=1 archetype
kit.furnitureArchetypes: subset of cover/divider/content, in that order

responses.notes: kit is only the PATCH that was applied (not the whole kit); already persisted.

body.error: layouts must map cover, divider and content to layout indices
Organization brands can only be edited by an admin
No rendered layout at index <n> — re-import the template

errors.when: a chosen layout-preview blob is missing (em dash U+2014); no writes happen

body.error: Rendered layout is not a PNG

errors.when: blob/DB failure, or furniture-all.json is not valid JSON (JSON.parse throws)

sideEffects: Copies layout-preview-<i>.png -> titleMaster.png / dividerMaster.png / master.png under brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/ (brand-archetypes.ts:58-62)
If brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/furniture-all.json exists and has layoutsByIndex: rewrites furniture.json from the chosen indices (media pruned) (brand-archetypes.ts:66-77; furniture.ts:67-89)
externalCalls: Supabase, Netlify Blobs; no paid APIs
quirks: Method check precedes auth (405 without a token) - opposite of /api/brands and /api/brand-pptx.
Not atomic: master blobs are written before the furniture rebuild and kit update; a later failure leaves masters overwritten.

furnitureRebuilt is true whenever furniture-all.json had layoutsByIndex, even if no chosen index existed in it (archetypes empty) - in that case no furniture fields are in kit and furniture.json is untouched.
Brands imported before per-layout capture (no furniture-all.json) -> furnitureRebuilt:false, existing furniture kept.
Response kit holds full canonical key strings (not `true`).
beforeAnyState: Before a PPTX import with brandId (no layout previews) -> 404 'No rendered layout at index <cover index> — re-import the template' (the three reads run concurrently in Promise.all, so <n> is whichever missing read rejects first - nondeterministic when several are missing).

tests.asserts: masters copied under brand owner; furniture.json rebuilt + kit patch returned; merge over stored kit; legacy brands keep furniture; fails before writing when a preview is missing (404); 403 read-only member; 404 unreachable; 400 bad mapping

callers.expects: {kit, furnitureRebuilt}; merges kit into editor state
